sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Rose Gold-Plated Floral Burst AD Ring
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Shine bright with this Rose gold-plated floral burst AD ring, featuring a stunning sparkling flower motif surrounded by shimmering American Diamonds. A stylish piece that adds the perfect sparkle to parties, weddings, or daily wear.
- Material: Brass base
- Plating: Premium Gold-plated finish
- Stone Type: American Diamond (AD)
- Design: Floral burst with studded band
- Size & Fit: Adjustable – fits comfortably on most finger sizes
- Style & Use: Perfect for festive wear, parties, weddings, and gifting
